content: WhatsApp _chat.txt parsing pitfalls corroborated across multiple independent parsers (whatsapp-export-parser, whatsapp-chat-to-pdf, whatsapp-export-viewer) and blogs (wachattopdf, threadrecap): (1) locale/device-dependent timestamp format - day-first vs month-first, 12/24h, 2/4-digit year, slash/period separators, localized AM/PM (p.m., م, ص, 上午/下午), Eastern Arabic-Indic digits; (2) multi-line messages need continuation-line stitching; (3) sender names containing ' : ' break naive colon split; (4) media placeholders vary: <Media omitted>, image omitted, sticker omitted, localized (الوسائط غير مضمنة), iOS <filename> vs Android 'filename (file attached)'; (5) deleted messages appear as 'This message was deleted'/'You deleted this message' not as media-omitted; (6) system messages (joins/leaves/encryption notice/security-code change/call logs) have timestamp but no sender; (7) macOS ._chat.txt AppleDouble resource-fork file corrupts glob parsers; (8) iPhone Export Chat silently truncates ~40,000 messages; (9) BOM and iOS bidi marks (U+200E/U+200F) must be stripped; (10) ambiguous all-days<=12 dates need whole-file heuristic.
